Visual learning guide — Hinglish mein
Taiyaar kiya: 18 November 2026
p.2: SAFE-Pipe ko simple Hinglish mein samjho: chhote examples, diagrams aur apni repository ke actual results ke saath. Basics se shuru karo, phir dekho ki kaam kis order mein aage badha.
p.3:
Guide ki date: 18 November 2026 · Evidence 7f9c1b0, 16 November 2026 tak ka hai
Research branch: codex/partition-probe-research · Original main baseline: 504f005
p.4: Puri written guide, figures aur tables JavaScript ke bina bhi padh sakte ho. Interactive calculators ke liye JavaScript chahiye; ye sirf tumhare browser mein calculations karte hain, koi data pipeline execute nahi karte.
p.5: Pehli reading: chapters 1–5, 9, 13, 20, 21 aur 23 padho. Isse project ki story, main numbers aur current position samajh aa jayegi. Doosri reading: model, memory aur sampling ke examples karo. Viva se pehle: glossary, short answers aur quiz revise karo.
p.6: Green boxes mein main takeaway hai. Yellow boxes mein limitations ya common confusion samjhayi gayi hai. Interactive examples learning ke liye hain, live benchmarks nahi. Source links actual repository files kholte hain; Markdown files browser mein plain text ki tarah bhi khul sakti hain.
p.7: Ek hi data operation ko alag worker counts, thread counts aur memory limits ke saath run kar sakte hain. Setting badalne se time, allocated resources aur kabhi-kabhi job complete hogi ya nahi—ye sab badal sakta hai.
p.8: Socho university office ke paas purchases ki ek badi spreadsheet hai. Har department ka total nikalna hai. Ek person saara kaam kar sakta hai, ya multiple logon mein baant sakte hain. Zyada log help kar sakte hain, lekin coordination mein bhi time lagta hai. Computer par aise choices ko hum configuration settings kehte hain.
p.9: Submitted title hai “SAFE-Pipe: Failure-Aware Cost and Runtime Optimization of Distributed Data Pipelines under SLA Constraints.” Lekin jo implementation humne actually measure ki hai, woh zyada specific hai: ek Windows PC par memory-capped local Dask. Humne AWS Glue service ya multiple physical machines wale cluster ko measure nahi kiya.
p.10: Ek chhoti measured table se LightGBM model train karo. Known workload ke liye eight settings ka runtime estimate karo aur eligible setting recommend karo.
p.11: Main evidence: 96 physical jobs, 13.84% test MdAPE aur explanations wala recommendation interface.
p.12: Controlled development studies karke dekho ki chhota sample full job ka behaviour batata hai ya nahi. Phir check karo ki sample ka apna cost pay karne ke baad decision sach mein better hota hai ya nahi.
p.13: Main evidence: 768-attempt screen, Stage A ke 48 full runs, Stage B ke 96 probes aur one-probe feasibility ka negative result.
p.15: Scanning mein reading aur filtering test hoti hai. Groupby same key wali rows ko combine karta hai. Join do tables ki matching rows jodta hai. Sorting rows ko key ke order mein lagati hai. Ye common data-engineering operations hain, aur inki resource needs alag hoti hain. Humne kisi ek isolated task ko pura project nahi banaya; humne multiple tasks se bane jobs ki settings choose karna study kiya.
p.16:
Input: IT ₹100, HR ₹50, IT ₹200.
Group karne ke baad output: IT ₹300, HR ₹50.
p.17: Actual benchmark synthetic numeric records use karta hai. Purchases wala example sirf operation samjhane ke liye hai.
p.18: Orders table mein customer IDs hain. Customer table mein ID aur region hai. Join karne se har order ke saath us customer ka region aa jata hai.
p.19: Shuffle mein rows ko move karna pad sakta hai taaki matching keys sahi worker tak pahunch jayein. Is coordination mein memory aur network/IPC ka kaam lag sakta hai.
p.20: Original advisor ek fixed, declared grid compare karta hai. ID ko aise padho: w2_t1_1g ka matlab 2 workers, har worker par 1 thread aur har worker ki 1 GB memory limit. Last value pure PC ki limit nahi hai.
p.21: Agar 2 workers hain aur har worker ki limit 1 GB hai, toh total 2 GB configured worker memory hui. Host PC mein lagbhag 31.4 GiB physical RAM hai, lekin experiment mein jaan-boojhkar smaller worker limits rakhi gayi. Scheduler, parent process, operating system aur baaki apps bhi RAM use karte hain.
p.22: GB aur GiB alag units hain: 1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes; 1 GiB = 1,073,741,824 bytes. Original fitted features mein legacy memory parsing thi. Naye advisor ke scores explicit SI/IEC byte parsing use karte hain. Purane trained features ka meaning chupke se change karne ke bajay unhe preserve kiya gaya hai.
p.24: Repository 25 October 2026 ko documentation, schemas aur optimizer ke saath start hoti hai. Early Windows handoff 26 October ke 13cf785 se linked hai. Git se ye code checkpoints verify hote hain; sirf Git dekhkar ye nahi pata chalta ki kisi person ne exact kis minute repository clone ki thi.
p.25: Project mein scope documents, typed records aur bounded optimizer tha. Schema batata hai ki workload, configuration ya result record mein kya fields honi chahiye. Optimizer diye gaye estimates compare kar sakta hai; iska matlab ye nahi ki estimates pehle hi measure ya learn ho chuke the.
p.26: Synthetic generators aur basic collection tools present the. Handoff mein 20 software tests report hue the. Experiment PC par actual Dask execution, data collection aur model fitting abhi karni thi.
p.27: Is Windows PC par humne actual Dask execution add kiya, small setup checks kiye, datasets aur deadlines freeze kiye, experiment matrix collect ki, table audit ki, original runtime model fit kiya aur policy/demo results record kiye.
p.28: Architecture, scope decisions, schemas, initial optimization logic, synthetic workload tools, tests aur ek plan pehle se tha.
p.29: Working physical Dask execution, real experiment records, audited dataset, fitted predictor, calibration, measured comparisons aur reproducible demonstration abhi chahiye the.
p.30: Broader synopsis mein Dask/Glue aur 176-run design propose hua tha. Internal feasibility decisions ke baad pehla implementation B-lite: ek local Dask PC aur 96-run matrix bana. Ye design change tha; sirf “80 runs baaki” wali baat nahi thi. Reduced scope ko supervisor ne accept kiya ya nahi, ye Git commit se prove nahi hota.
p.32: Original profiles mein har family ka compressed Parquet input lagbhag 175–198 MB tha. Logical row counts kaafi different the. Compressed file size, rows ki count aur RAM mein required working set ek hi cheez nahi hain.
p.33: Declared reference setting par three pilot engine runtimes ke median ka 1.5 × lekar deadlines freeze ki gayi; result ko 0.1 seconds tak round up kiya gaya. Baad mein results achhe dikhane ke liye deadlines change nahi ki gayi. T0/T0b checks aur SLA pilots, 96 scored jobs se separate the.
p.34: 27–28 October ko explained advise interface mein balanced/resource/fastest ranking, budgets, candidate explanations aur stronger support checks add hue. Isne existing model reuse kiya. Iske 20 replay scenarios 20 naye physical jobs nahi the. Us checkpoint par integrated Windows suite mein 79 tests pass hue aur work central main tak push hua.
p.36: Original model successful engine runtime ko seconds mein predict karta hai. Har workload/configuration combination ke liye ek feature row milti hai. Eight settings compare karne ke liye eight feature rows banate hain: workload description same rehti hai, configuration fields badalti hain.
p.38: Ye fields batati hain ki operation kis type ka hai, input ka size/layout kya hai aur declared skew tag kya hai.
p.40: Ye fields us candidate setting ko describe karti hain jiska runtime hum model se pooch rahe hain.
p.41: Ye 12 named input fields hain. Family aur configuration ID indicator columns mein encode hoti hain—jaise “kya ye groupby hai?” aur “kya ye setting w2… hai?” Saved fitted feature list mein 22 encoded columns hain.
p.42: Training ka target label measured engine_seconds hai, jiska natural log liya jata hai. Model ko usi job ka future runtime, future spill, failure status ya future peak RAM prediction input mein nahi milta. Aisa karne se answer pehle hi de doge; ise data leakage kehte hain.
p.43: Frozen main-v1 groupby profile aur w1_t1_1g setting ki actual feature row:
p.44: 0.1 skew score original workload contract ka frozen descriptor hai, nayi learned probability nahi. Doosra candidate choose karne se uski setting fields change hoti hain. Inference saved model load karta hai; har job se pehle naya model train nahi hota.
p.46: LightGBM ek gradient-boosted decision-tree library hai. Decision tree input values ke baare mein questions poochta hai aur end mein numerical estimate deta hai. Boosting mein multiple trees bante hain; later trees pehle ki mistakes correct karne mein help karte hain. Hamara numerical target log runtime hai.
p.47: Ek toy tree pooch sakta hai: “Kya operation sort hai?” aur “Kya setting mein ek se zyada execution threads hain?” Ye sirf samjhane wale questions hain, actual fitted trees ki copy nahi. Actual model mein learned split thresholds aur leaf values hain.
p.48: Original model ko frozen training split par ek baar fit kiya gaya. Hyperparameters fixed the; humne unhe extensive hyperparameter search ka result claim nahi kiya. Later advisor aur probing work mein naya model train nahi hua.
p.49: Runtime positive hota hai aur uska difference ratio ke form mein useful hota hai: 2 se 4 seconds double hai, jaise 10 se 20 seconds double hai. Log scale aise multiplicative differences represent karta hai. Output ko exponentiate karke seconds mein wapas laate hain. Calibration upper bound bhi multiplicative factor use karta hai.
p.51: Table mein 32 family/configuration groups hain, har group ke three physical repeats hain. Example: “groupby at w2_t1_2g.” Kisi group ke teeno repeats ko humne ek hi split mein rakha.
p.52: Socho ek setting ka repeat 1 training mein aur usi workload/setting ka repeat 2 testing mein chala gaya. Test example phir training example se bahut similar hoga. Repeats ko saath rakhne se ye particular leakage avoid hoti hai.
p.53: Original predictor successful jobs se learn karta hai. Original 96 scored jobs sab successful the, isliye ye table failure classifier ko failure ka pattern nahi sikha sakti.
p.55: Classifier category predict karta hai, jaise “spam / not spam.” Hamara runtime regressor number predict karta hai, jaise “3.2 seconds.” Prediction thodi galat ya bahut galat ho sakti hai. Isliye simple right/wrong accuracy ke bajay percentage error zyada useful hai.
p.56: Example: actual runtime 10 seconds aur predicted runtime 12 seconds ho, toh 20% error. Agar errors 5%, 10% aur 40% hain, median 10% hai. Values sort karne ke baad middle value median hoti hai; even count mein beech ki do values ka average lete hain.
p.57: Ye sirf calculation samjhane ke liye hai. Isse LightGBM call nahi hota.
p.59: Agar model 3 seconds predict kare aur deadline 3.1 seconds ho, toh sirf point estimate par accept karne mein underprediction ki bahut kam gunjaish bachegi. Isliye deadline ko upper runtime estimate se compare karte hain.
p.60: Original calibration one-sided split conformal logic use karti hai. Simple meaning: calibration jobs mein model ne kitna underestimate kiya, woh dekho; har setting ke three repeats ko group karo; ranked residual se cautious adjustment set karo. Saved log adjustment 0.523642 hai.
p.61: Illustrative point prediction 3.00 seconds ho, toh upper estimate lagbhag 5.06 seconds hoga. 5-second deadline par ye candidate reject hoga; 6-second deadline par ye particular check pass kar sakta hai.
p.62: SLA ka matlab deadline ya service requirement hai. Original advisor ki deadline engine execution ke liye hai; cluster startup, profiling aur advice time us frozen target mein include nahi hain. Later research full lifecycle aur complete-request costs dekhti hai, kyunki user ko woh time bhi experience hota hai.
p.64: Historical recommend-model policy point runtime × (allocated vCPUs + allocated GB) use karti hai. Newer advise layer configured resources normalize karke balanced, resource aur fastest modes deti hai. Predictor same hai, lekin score aur selected setting different ho sakte hain.
p.65: Ye weights preferences batate hain; LightGBM ne inhe learn nahi kiya. Score dimensionless hai aur configured resources use karta hai. Ye rupees/dollars ka bill, measured electricity ya actual RAM utilization nahi hai.
p.66: Ye local teaching replay committed balanced_examples.json ki saved predictions use karta hai. Model load, Dask launch ya doosre computer ki validation nahi hoti. Default results saved balanced choices reproduce karte hain. Deadline/mode change karne se unhi frozen predictions par eligibility aur scores dobara calculate hote hain.
p.67: Older policy ki four family-level median costs ka mean 7.524 tha; declared default ka 11.421. Ye 34.1% lower descriptive same-table cost hai. Model ne source table ke kuch cells se learn kiya tha, isliye independent improvement estimate nahi hai. Ye older objective ka result bhi hai, later balanced score ka nahi.
p.70: Sirf LightGBM train karna aur Dask add karna apne aap mein naya scientific method nahi hai. Later direction ka specific question tha: kya cheap input samples configuration choose karne mein help karte hain, jab full job memory pressure mein alag behave kare?
p.71: Probe sampled input par chhota trial execution hota hai. Full execution ka decision lene se pehle actual behaviour observe kar sakte hain. Lekin agar probe ka cost usse milne wali saving se zyada ho, toh us request ke liye ye achha option nahi.
p.72: Quarter-size job RAM mein comfortably chal sakti hai, jabki full job spill ya restart threshold cross kare. Chhoti job ka stable result phir bhi full case ko galat represent kar sakta hai.
p.73: Sample ko sirf kuch seconds lag sakte hain, lekin full job bhi kuch seconds ki ho sakti hai. Multiple samples ka total cost seedha reasonable setting par full job chalane se zyada ho sakta hai.
p.74: Partition-aware ka matlab input kaise divided hai, uspar dhyan dena. Adaptive ka matlab available evidence ke basis par decide karna ki ab kya inspect karein ya aage kaise badhein. Ye research aims the; validated online adaptive controller establish nahi hua.
p.75: Simple baselines zaroori hain. Agar file sizes ki rule bina probe chalaye same achha decision le leti hai, toh probe ko extra value dikhani padegi. Sirf complicated hone se technique better nahi ho jati.
p.77: Families groupby aur skewed join thi. Fact inputs mein 500,000, 1,000,000 ya 2,000,000 rows the. Initial patterns balanced aur uneven the. Uneven design mein key skew aur file imbalance saath badle the; isi wajah se baad mein cleaner Stage A study ki gayi.
p.78: Monitored screen 14 November ko 00:08 IST par complete hui: 759 successes, one timeout aur eight execution errors. Saare planned attempts record mein rakhe gaye. Timeout ke saath recorded power interruption preserve hui. Eight worker-death errors ko OS out-of-memory kills prove nahi kiya gaya.
p.80: Har instance ke liye probe woh setting choose kar sakta hai jo use fastest lagti hai. Phir us setting ka actual full-engine time dekhkar fastest complete full reference se compare karte hain.
p.81: Matched-memory uniform ke comparison mein partition-tail two instances par better, three par equal aur five par worse tha. Isliye ranking results ne partition-tail ka advantage establish nahi kiya. Sirf two runtime repeats aur one generation seed hone se evidence limited tha.
p.82: 0.11% median regret ka matlab 99.89% prediction accuracy nahi. Ye chosen setting ke full runtime ko best eligible full setting se compare karta hai. Ismein profiling cost include nahi, reliability prove nahi hoti aur unseen workloads ki generalization measure nahi hoti. Saare twelve instances par replay mein selected settings ke three recorded full outcomes unsuccessful bhi the.
p.83: Later screen review mein eight probes per instance aur preparation ka constructed median cost 31.20 seconds tha; matched historical fixed full comparator ka 3.80 seconds. Ye old measurements se cost construction hai, fresh online request nahi. Isse pata chala ki sirf ranking metric improve hona kaafi nahi.
p.85: Key skew mein kuch key values bahut zyada baar aati hain. Partition imbalance mein input files/chunks ke row counts bahut unequal hote hain. Dono saath aa sakte hain, lekin same cheez nahi hain. Stage A mein inhe separately vary kiya gaya.
p.86: Stage A mein two million fact rows, seed 911, eight fact files, two single-thread workers aur har worker par 1 GB ya 2 GB cap tha. Joins mein declared dimension relation retain hui. One new generation seed aur three runtime repeats development diagnosis hain; broad independent validation nahi.
p.87: Overall 41 successes aur seven execution errors the. Har error ke saath retained Dask nanny memory-termination evidence tha. Nine attempts mein aisa evidence tha; unmein se two attempts eventually successful bhi hue. System ne 37 worker-termination events collect kiye—ye 37 failed jobs nahi hain.
p.88: Sirf “worker died” message se exact problem nahi samajh aati. Stage A mein worker summaries, supervisor logs, scheduler events, active thresholds, process exits aur file hashes temporary-spill cleanup ke baad bhi retain hue. Isliye baad mein lost message recover karne ke liye benchmark rerun kiye bina investigation kar sakte hain.
p.90: Stage A ke existing 48 full outcomes historical references ke roop mein reuse hue; rerun nahi hue. Stage B mein 16 deterministic samples bane—har instance/fraction ka ek—jo caps aur repeats mein reuse hue. Dono fractions ke samples non-nested the. Join mein full right-hand dimension retained thi; sirf fact rows sample hui.
p.91: Full memory budget dene se sample artificially comfortable ho sakta hai. Stage B ne fixed floor wali declared memory mapping use ki:
p.92: Ye frozen Stage B mapping ki calculation hai, koi probe run nahi ho raha.
p.93: Floor ka idea hai ki har memory cost fact-row count ke proportion mein kam nahi hota. Ye protocol choice hai, measured 512 MiB idle baseline nahi. Lagbhag 75 MB initial worker RSS dekhkar floor ko replace karna justified nahi: graph state, joins aur baaki allocations same proportion mein scale zaroori nahi karte.
p.94: 96/96 probes successful aur “quiet” the: declared spill/pause/restart/nanny warning ya quality flag nahi mila. Lekin 32 comparison groups mein se eight mein quiet probes ke historical full references par pressure tha. Ye four instance/low-cap cases ko two fractions par dekhna hai, eight independent unseen workloads nahi.
p.95: Six-probe selection replay ne har instance ke liye 1 GB choose kiya, jo 17/24 historical full successes se map hua. Fixed 2 GB aur file-metadata baseline 24/24 par map hue. Ye existing table ke outcomes hain, naye policy executions nahi.
p.97: Retained research settings mein multiple action thresholds hain. System worker budget cross hone se pehle react karne ki koshish karta hai. Monitoring checks ke beech memory badal bhi sakti hai; limit operating system ki hard sandbox wall nahi hai.
p.98: 1 GB cap par process pressure lagbhag 700 MB ho toh worker spill kar sakta hai, bhale hi 1,000 MB tak nahi pahucha. Managed-data target ke paas bhi spill shuru ho sakta hai. Agar active task bahut tezi se allocate kare, next monitor check react karne se pehle thresholds cross ho sakte hain.
p.99: Records mein peak stored spilled disk bytes aur cumulative spill-write bytes dono hain. Pehla spill store ka largest observed retained size hai; doosra time ke saath total writes count karta hai. Dono equal hona zaroori nahi. Temporary scratch storage, permanent datasets aur diagnostic logs se alag category hai.
p.101: Exporter ne 144 Stage A/B attempts se 321 worker lifetimes recover ki. Stage A: 129 lifetimes—96 initial, 33 added. Stage B: 192 initial lifetimes. Process restart ho toh uski nayi lifetime row hoti hai. Saari readings ko mila kar imaginary never-restarted worker nahi banate.
p.102: Collector har 50 ms sample leta hai aur lagbhag har 250 ms snapshot save karta hai. Recorded memory-monitor interval 100 ms hai. Ye mechanisms asynchronous hain. Last saved sample ke baad sudden termination ho sakti hai; checks ke beech short-lived peak bhi aa sakti hai.
p.103: Actual exported lifetime A:b1c5da22aac9c6f6d07d814f:w02 ka saved peak 638,382,080 bytes tha, lekin nanny event ne 1,000,000,000-byte cap par 999,092,224 bytes observe kiye. Matlab cap ka lagbhag 63.8% versus 99.9%. Dono readings ko unke respective sources ke saath preserve karna chahiye.
p.104: Baseline RSS pehla plugin sample hai; guaranteed clean idle memory nahi. Largest observed RSS bhi ek observation hai, true continuous-time maximum nahi. Isliye prototype in memory representations ko exact_peak_known=false aur automatic_regression_target=false mark karta hai.
p.105: Read-only export ne 1,507 diagnostic-file hashes check kiye, saare 321 snapshots telemetry se match kiye aur missing values ko null/blank rakha. Eight synthetic exporter tests pass hue. Iske liye koi naya physical benchmark nahi chahiye tha.
p.107: Next idea mein six-probe workflow ko reduce karke har decision ke liye one quarter-size, low-target-cap observation use hui. Har worker ke sampled peak ko uske effective cap se divide karke maximum ratio liya. Baad mein chosen 0.55 cutoff ne current development groups separate kiye.
p.108: Lekin input metadata se hi same four low-cap aur four high-cap choices ho rahi thi. Development table mein visible separation kaafi nahi: probe ko cheaper baseline ke upar useful decision value dikhani hogi.
p.109: Metadata matlab sample workload execute kiye bina milne wale facts: row counts, largest fact-file ka row count, payload columns aur dimension rows. Prototype in descriptors se dense-input memory scenarios banata hai.
p.110: Upper scenario agar 1 GB cap ke 70% se zyada nahi hai, toh 1 GB select karo. Warna same rule par 2 GB dekho; dono mein fit na ho toh abstain. Ye hand-set development assumptions hain, actual measured RSS ya guaranteed statistical memory bounds nahi.
p.111: Two million fact rows, 16 payload columns, no dimension aur eight equal files: D = 272 MB; L = 34 MB.
p.112: Upper scenario = 134.22 + 136 + 102 = 372.22 MB. Ye 700 MB se kam hai, toh rule 1 GB select karti hai.
p.113: Largest fact file = 1.3 million rows. L = 176.8 MB; total D ab bhi 272 MB hai.
p.114: Upper scenario = 134.22 + 136 + 530.4 = 800.62 MB. Ye 700 MB se zyada lekin 1,400 MB mein fit hai, toh rule 2 GB select karti hai.
p.115: Ye counterfactual replays hain: “Is ek existing observation par ye rule kya choose karti?” Ye newly executed requests nahi. Har decision ko ek probe observation milti hai; three repeats ko average karke input nahi banate aur independent new workloads ki tarah count nahi karte.
p.116: Checked-in policy mein admission_enabled=false hai. Bahut optimistic supplied cost estimates bhi probe permit nahi karte. Pure decision module metadata se select ya abstain kar sakta hai. Proposed 48-attempt pilot mein enabled=false hai aur execution runner implement nahi hua.
p.118: 16 November ko Windows checkout 82d40af tak fast-forward hua. Existing research environment mein checks-only command chalayi. First attempt pass hui; implementation fix, policy change ya threshold change ki zaroorat nahi padi.
p.119: Report aur updated context 7f9c1b0 commit se codex/partition-probe-research par push hue. Main 504f005 par raha. Report mein verified code revision 82d40af hai; later commit verification evidence publish karti hai. Dono commit IDs ka role alag hai.
p.121: Research cost proxy declared 0.5 time / 0.25 threads / 0.25 memory weights aur fixed normalizers preserve karti hai. Ismein sampling aur paid profiling ka cost include karna zaroori hai; ye measured cloud price nahi. Alag formulas ke numerical scores ko same unit samajhkar compare mat karo.
p.123: Is arithmetic se amortized SAFE-Pipe result establish nahi hota. Actual reuse, data drift, baselines ko fair cluster reuse aur resource costs ke liye alag protocol chahiye. Ye investigate karne ka possible question hai, current proven project claim nahi.
p.125: 7f9c1b0 tak published research history mein 39 reachable commits hain: original main baseline tak 20 aur 504f005 ke baad 19 research-only commits. Author identity “Codex” ke 25 aur “Daksh Aggarwal” ke 14 commits hain. Ye provenance hai; individual intellectual contribution ka score nahi.
p.126: Dates Git ke commit-author dates hain. Descriptions saved changes batati hain; har commit experiment nahi hoti. Links exact GitHub commit kholte hain. Original commit messages evidence ke liye English mein preserve kiye gaye hain.
p.127: Ganant Work.md batata hai ki is PC par kya hua aur evidence kahan hai. context.md current research position aur constraints batata hai. Commit IDs ke saath ye files teammate ya doosre AI ko continue karne mein help karti hain, bina old proposals ko current instructions samjhe. Raw data local/ignored rehta hai; compact reviewable results Git mein jaate hain.
p.129: JSON structured record hai. JSONL mein har line par ek JSON record hota hai. CSV flat table hai. Parquet column-oriented data-file format hai. Manifest dataset/files ki identities aur metadata list karta hai. SHA-256 hash saved reference ke against bytes change hue ya nahi, ye check karta hai; scientific conclusion correct hai ya nahi, ye prove nahi karta.
p.130: Clone mein code, compact evidence aur fitted artifacts ho sakte hain, lekin ignored local raw files na hon. Isliye “Git pull kar liya” ka matlab “mere paas har original dataset aa gaya” nahi hai. Credentials committed evidence se bahar rehte hain aur is guide mein include nahi hain.
p.131: Alag workers, threads aur memory settings se same job fast, slow ya resource-heavy ho sakti hai. Hum deadline aur available evidence ki limits respect karke execution se pehle bounded settings compare karne ka transparent tareeka banana chahte hain.
p.132: Baseline ek simpler comparison hai jisse hum compare karte hain ya seekhte hain: fixed setting, family-median runtime ya metadata rule. Original advisor fitted predictor use karta hai; research mein additional probes investigate hue. Baseline practical winner bhi ho sakti hai—jaise current one-probe comparison mein metadata.
p.133: Family operation category hai, jaise groupby. Instance particular input hai jiska size, seed, layout aur skew pattern fixed hai. Ek instance ko baar-baar run karne se independent workload families ki count nahi badhti.
p.134: Key skew mein keys ki frequency unequal hoti hai—jaise ek customer ID bahut baar aaye. Partition imbalance mein file/chunk sizes unequal hote hain. Dono computation ko alag tarah affect kar sakte hain; Stage A mein factors separately vary hue.
p.135: Straggler woh task ya worker hai jo baaki sabse bahut zyada time lekar overall job delay kare. Ek bahut bada partition ya expensive key group aisa bottleneck bana sakta hai. Sirf input layout dekhkar har straggler ka exact cause prove nahi hota.
p.136: Probe chhota trial execution hai. Fidelity poochti hai ki sample full job ka relevant behaviour preserve karta hai ya nahi. Sample apne data ka correct answer de sakta hai, phir bhi full-job memory pressure ya setting ranking ko misrepresent kar sakta hai.
p.137: Repeat same experimental condition ko dobara run karke timing/outcome variation dekhta hai. Isse noise assess hota hai. Size, seed ya family independently change nahi hoti; repeats ko independent workloads bolne se evidence diversity badha-chadha kar dikhegi.
p.138: Regression number predict karta hai. Residual observed outcome aur prediction ka difference hai; hamari calibration mein log scale par define hai. Overfitting mein model training data ki aisi quirks learn kare jo new data par na chalein. Small trees, regularization aur grouped test help karte hain, lekin broad generalization prove nahi karte.
p.139: OOD matlab out of distribution: input available evidence se different hai. Abstention matlab support ya constraints sufficient na hon toh recommendation dene se mana karna. Older gate family/size heuristics use karta tha; explained advisor exact frozen descriptors maangta hai. Isse arbitrary unseen jobs validated nahi ho jati.
p.140: Nahi. Original study mein failures nahi the, isliye deterministic guards the. Later research mein failures aur worker events aaye, lekin concentrated development observations se general calibrated failure model establish nahi hota. Worker terminations aur independent failed-job examples ek hi unit nahi hain.
p.141: Success matlab recorded attempt complete hui. Quiet matlab declared warnings nahi aur recorded quality acceptable hai. “Safe” ek stronger claim hai jo broadly establish nahi hua. Successful full job mein bhi spill ya worker restarts ho sakte hain.
p.142: Replay existing measurements par decision rule apply karta hai. Counterfactual poochta hai ki doosri rule us evidence par kya select karti. Inse automatically nayi online request, fresh selected job ya independent real-world performance measure nahi hoti.
p.143: Oracle analysis-only comparator hai jise outcome baad mein pata hone ki permission hoti hai. Isse optimistic headroom estimate kar sakte hain; real pre-run decision ko ye future knowledge nahi de sakte. Agar optimistic saving bhi profiling repay na kare, toh feasibility ki strong warning milti hai.
p.144: Method, objective, supported domain aur baselines freeze karo; phir untouched workload groups par evaluate karo. Pura decision/request cost count karo aur online-performance claims ke liye selected full job actually execute karo. Final test par tune karke use untouched mat bolo.
p.145: Novelty ke liye existing research ke comparison mein meaningful contribution chahiye, sirf new codebase nahi. Profiling, memory-based tuning aur multi-fidelity search par related research hai. Hamari infrastructure aur negative findings useful hain, lekin validated new selector aur publishable contribution abhi establish nahi hue.
p.146: Measured result named saved experiment/report se aata hai. Toy example invented numbers se idea samjhata hai. Guide mein toy calculations aur conceptual figures label kiye hain; unke numbers ko actual experimental results ki tarah quote mat karo.
p.147: Dono ek particular small table aur defined rule ke results hain. Coverage mein upper estimate ko observed runtime se compare karte hain; success mein job completion dekhte hain. Dono automatically universal success probability ya unseen workloads par performance proof nahi hain.
p.148: Hash audit prove karta hai ki checked files saved expected identities se match karti hain. Ye provenance preserve aur accidental changes detect karne mein help karta hai. Statistical design, novelty, causal interpretation ya future reliability ko certify nahi karta.
p.149: “Humne local Dask configuration advisor banaya aur four profiles ko eight settings aur three repeats par measure kiya. LightGBM ka test median percentage error 13.84% tha, lekin workload diversity limited thi. Phir samples se memory-sensitive full jobs ki settings choose karna investigate kiya. Screen, Stage A aur Stage B mein sample/full mismatch aur saved memory peaks ki limitations mili. One-probe rule metadata ke upar apna cost pay karke better decision nahi dikha payi. Guarded implementation Windows tests mein pass hui, lekin admission disabled hai aur ab research hypothesis redesign karni hai.”
p.150: English guide 18 November 2026 ko connected remote check karke banayi gayi thi; ye usi ka Hinglish version hai. Evidence checkpoint 7f9c1b0, 16 November ka hai. Ye learning document hai, naya experiment, training report ya official completion assessment nahi. Later documentation commits is frozen evidence count mein include nahi hain.
p.151: Jahan repository answer nahi deti—jaise training-set accuracy, officially accepted completion percentage ya independent research-policy accuracy—wahan hum clearly bolte hain ki result available nahi. Gap fill karne ke liye convenient number nahi banate.
p.152: Figures original explanatory SVG/CSS illustrations hain. Runtime demos ki saved values isi file mein embedded hain, isliye server ya internet ke bina guide chalti hai. Source links repository root se best work karte hain. Page padhne se ML API request ya workload start nahi hota. Technical identifiers, formulas aur original commit messages ko faithful reference ke liye English mein rakha hai.

callouts: Puri guide ka sabse useful distinctionNayi probing research mein original LightGBM model retrain nahi hua. Humne alag decision strategy investigate ki. Runtime comparisons, memory observations aur software tests alag types ke evidence hain.

Zyada workers ka matlab automatically faster job nahi.Processes start karna, work split karna, data shuffle karna aur results combine karna bhi time leta hai. Small jobs mein coordination overhead parallelism ke benefit se zyada ho sakta hai. Isliye humne settings measure ki; largest setting ko automatically winner nahi maana.

Kya project exactly 50% complete tha?Honest statement hai: “pehla measured prototype complete tha; independent evaluation aur final delivery baaki thi.” Exact overall percentage ke liye official rubric supplied nahi hai. Sirf 50% dikhane ke liye denominator badha dena real progress prove nahi karega.

Parameters naam se teen alag cheezeinInput features particular request describe karte hain. Training hyperparameters control karte hain ki LightGBM kaise seekhe. Decision preferences speed aur configured resources ka trade-off batati hain. Ye alag layers hain.

Kya hamare paas deep-learning model hai?Core fitted predictor LightGBM hai, yani boosted-tree model. Optional TabPFN comparison propose hua tha, executed record nahi hai. Proposed comparison ko implemented model mat bolo.

Main limitation ab bhi yaad rakhoStudy mein four workload profiles represented hain. Kuch settings hold out karna, completely unseen families, sizes, skew ya hardware par test karne jaisa nahi. Test diversity eight family/configuration groups hai, 24 independent new workload types nahi.

13.84% ka actual meaning kya hai?Is bounded study mein middle test-row percentage error lagbhag 13.84% tha. Har prediction 13.84% ke andar hogi, aisa nahi. Aur 100 − 13.84 = 86.16% koi reported accuracy metric nahi hai.

Coverage aur success probability same nahi.Small test mein 24/24 observed coverage se universal 100% coverage prove nahi hoti. Isse selected settings ya new profiles ki 90% success probability bhi prove nahi hoti. In claims ke liye separate evidence chahiye.

Actual achievement kya tha?Humne reproducible bounded advisor banaya aur behaviour measure kiya. Next step ye samajhna tha ki small controlled evidence kahan insufficient ho jata hai; completion percentage inflate karna nahi.

Har historical partial count ko 768 mein add mat karo.Earlier smoke runs, separate 36-cell partial Windows plan aur historical Mac partial plans ka apna scope/limitations hai. Ye completed screen ki extra independent validation nahi. Screen ka intermediate 68-cell checkpoint pehle se uske 768 ka part hai.

Yahan kya seekha?Reproducible experiment system bana, sample/full disagreement mila aur unsupported “partition-tail better hai” claim reject hua. Negative evidence ne next question narrow kiya; bas aur runs karne ka excuse nahi banaya.

False-reassurance candidate ka matlab sirf failed job nahi.Full warning label mein spill/pause/restart aur failures shamil hain. Kuch full jobs pressure ke bawajood complete hui. Isliye eight discrepancy groups ko calibrated 25% false-negative rate ya 75% classifier accuracy mat bolo.

Runs se disk space kyun badha?Datasets, reusable samples, retained results aur diagnostics disk par rehte hain. Temporary Dask spill alag category hai. “Multiple attempts ke baad 6 GB” ka matlab har raw JSON result hundreds of MB ka nahi. Repeats inputs reuse kar sakte hain; datasets, samples aur logs ki lifetimes alag hoti hain.

Do arithmetic mistakes avoid karoHar worker lifetime ka maximum add karne se simultaneous cluster RAM nahi milti, especially restarts ke baad. Alag time par measured managed-memory peak ko RSS peak se subtract karke reliable unmanaged memory nahi nikal sakte.

Negative result bhi useful hai.In short one-shot jobs mein metadata ke upar extra information benefit aur profiling payback demonstrate nahi hua. Validated improvement claim karne ke bajay explicit decision contracts implement kiye aur evidence ki limits preserve ki.

“38 tests passed” ka matlab “38 experiments successful” nahi.Tests synthetic in-memory examples se code paths check karte hain. Kuch tests copied policy temporarily enable karte hain; checked-in policy enable, cluster start ya general policy accuracy prove nahi karte. Historical 79, 54, 74, 8 aur 38 suites alag checkpoints/scopes ke hain; inhe add karke current total mat banao.

Current position ko aise bol sakte ho“Original advisor small measured Dask grid ka runtime predict karta hai. Phir humne memory pressure mein samples se decisions improve karna study kiya. Sample/full mismatch aur measurement limits mile, lekin current probing rules metadata ke upar cost pay karke useful benefit nahi dikha payi. Guarded code verify ho gaya; probing disabled hai aur ab method redesign ki stage hai.”

Commit count aur push count alag hain.Commit ek change record karti hai; push ek ya multiple commits upload karta hai. Normal Git history exact network push count ya kisne Push button dabaya, ye record nahi karti. Counts stated checkpoint ki published branch ke hain, har repo branch ke nahi. English/Hinglish guides ki later publication us frozen snapshot mein count nahi hai.
